label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
definition: Organization or business unit X is a subsidiary, division, owned business or organizational part of parent organization Y.
scope_notes: Preserves prior child-to-parent subsidiary/unit scope. Explicit part, unit, subsidiary or owned-by qualifies. Ordinary employment, a geographic site standing for an unnamed unit, and partial investment alone do not establish the same fact.
